“嘭！”

下一秒，李青山一脚踹在赵贵家单薄的木门上，势大力沉，反锁在后面的门栓瞬间被崩裂，发出一道沉闷的巨响。

“卧槽！”

后面看热闹的邻居纷纷忍不住惊叫出声，脸上满是震惊之色。

不仅仅是李青山的果敢，还有这一脚的力量。

大门踹开后，李青山直接迈步朝着院子内走去，大壮二壮等人一脸懵逼和震惊中。

山哥这也太猛了。

门栓都断了？

房间内的赵贵也被吓了一跳，目光朝着外面看去，正巧见到李青山从房门走了进来。

“赵贵，从我家滚出去！”李青山怒斥道。

“什么你家，这是我家，我们生活了好几代的家，怎么是你的了？”

“儿子，揍他！”

赵贵见状，硬着头皮道。

“嘭嘭嘭……！”

紧接着。

众人便听到房间内传来一道道沉闷的击打声，伴随着的还有一道道惨叫声。

“不好，山哥，我来助你！”

大壮见状，二话没说，便朝着赵贵的房间内冲了进去，二壮也紧跟其后。

然而。

还未等到大壮冲进去，便看到李青山一只手拎着一个宛若死狗一般的人走了出来，正是赵贵父子，此刻被打的皮青脸肿，被李青山从房间内一路拖到了外面。

如同死狗一般直接丢了出去。

赵贵的婆娘被吓得颤栗着身子，急忙一路小跑到门外，跪在自家爷们面前哀嚎着。

“哎呦，我的命怎么这么苦啊！”

“天杀的李青山，你就欺负我们家……有本事你去欺负别人啊……！”

“我的儿啊，你看这让李青山这个二流子给打的哦！”

“李青山怎么能这样，直接动手？”

“再怎么，也不能动手啊，都是邻居。”

“就是！”

周围村民纷纷指着地上痛哭的赵贵一家，开口道。

王乃香早已背好了自己的行李，小心翼翼躲在一旁，不敢有丝毫动作，那副小心的模样，真是令人心疼。

“大壮，二壮，进去把赵贵一家子的东西都给我搬出来，这是我李青山的家，怎么能放外人的东西？”

李青山开口道。

“好嘞！”

大壮和二壮点头应下，冲进院子后，便开始将赵贵家中的锅碗瓢盆全部扔了出来，和自己玩耍无赖这一招，没用。

“没天理，没天理了啊……！”

“李青山，你就是村霸，恶霸，土匪，你不是人啊，你欺负我们一家子……！”赵贵一屁股坐在地上，痛苦哀嚎着。

李青山眉头紧皱，农村传谣可是很厉害的。

要是将自己这种名声传出去，也不太好，日后难免会影响到什么，当即将土地房产所有证拿了出来道：“赵贵，你老老实实看着，你家的房子三十六块钱已经卖给我了，就连土地房产所有证上写着的都是我李青山的名字，这是政府给公正过的。”

“你要是说我是土匪，强占了你家的房子。”

“那政府是什么？”

“也是土匪，帮我这个土匪强占了你家的房子是不是？”

“就凭你刚刚这句话，公安就要来抓你，污蔑政府形象，你信不信？”

静！！

李青山话音落下，赵贵一家子顿时懵逼了。

这……这么严重吗？

抹黑政府，这可不敢干啊！

“还有你们，都是邻居，我提醒你们一句，这是政府给的土地房产所有证，你们要是说我李青山强占了赵贵一家的房子，就是在污蔑和抹黑政府，与我李青山一起狼狈为奸，官民勾结！”

“到时候，公安来抓你们，可不要害怕。”

李青山指着手中的证道：“一个买，一个卖，愿打愿挨，没什么好说的，这房子早就是我李青山的了，多给赵贵住了几天，已经算是看在是同村邻居的面子上。”

“实在是赵贵得寸进尺。”

污蔑，抹黑政府。

这个锅，在这个年代，谁也不敢背上啊！！

“说得对，这房子早就卖给人家李青山了，人家李青山能给你住几天就算不错了，还赖着不走，我看是你们一家子想要霸占人家李青山的房子。”

“赵贵，你们也太不讲理了。”

"Bang!"

The next second, Li Qingshan kicked the thin wooden door of Zhao Gui's house with such force that the door bolt locked behind instantly cracked, making a dull loud noise.

"Fuck!"

The neighbors who were watching the excitement behind them couldn't help but screamed in surprise, their faces full of shock.

Not only Li Qingshan's courage, but also the power of this kick.

After the door was kicked open, Li Qingshan walked directly towards the courtyard. Da Zhuang, Er Zhuang and others looked confused and shocked.

Brother Shan, this is too fierce.

Are the door bolts broken?

Zhao Gui in the room was also startled. He looked outside and happened to see Li Qingshan walking in from the door.

"Zhao Gui, get out of my house!" Li Qingshan yelled angrily.

"What is your home? This is my home. The home we have lived in for several generations, why is it yours?"

"Son, beat him!"

Zhao Gui saw this and said bravely.

"Bang bang bang...!"

Immediately afterwards.

Everyone heard dull blows coming from the room, accompanied by screams.

"No, Brother Shan, let me help you!"

Upon seeing this, Da Zhuang rushed into Zhao Gui's room without saying a word, followed closely by Er Zhuang.

However.

Before Da Zhuang could rush in, he saw Li Qingshan walking out with a person who looked like a dead dog in one hand. It was Zhao Gui and his son. At this moment, their skin was bruised and swollen, and they were dragged all the way out of the room by Li Qingshan.

It was thrown out like a dead dog.

Zhao Gui's mother-in-law was so frightened that she trembled and hurriedly ran out the door, kneeling in front of her husband and wailing.

"Oh, why is my life so miserable!"

"Damn it, Li Qingshan, you just bullied our family... If you have the ability, you can bully others...!"

"My son, look at what this second-rate guy like Li Qingshan did to him!"

"How could Li Qingshan do this and take action directly?"

"No matter what, you can't do anything, we are all neighbors."

"That's right!"

The surrounding villagers pointed to the Zhao Gui family crying on the ground and said.

Wang Naixiang had already packed her luggage and was hiding aside carefully, not daring to make the slightest move. That cautious look was really heartbreaking.

"Dazhuang, Erzhuang, go in and move out all the belongings of Zhao Gui and his family. This is my home, Li Qingshan, how can I put outsiders' things away?"

Li Qingshan said.

"Okay!"

Da Zhuang and Er Zhuang nodded in agreement. After rushing into the yard, they began to throw out all the pots and pans in Zhao Gui's house. This trick of playing rogue with themselves was useless.

"There is no justice, there is no justice...!"

"Li Qingshan, you are the village bully, a bully, and a bandit. You are not a human being. You bully our family...!" Zhao Gui sat down on the ground, wailing in pain.

Li Qingshan frowned. Rumors in rural areas were very powerful.

It would not be good if his reputation was spread. It would inevitably have some impact in the future. He immediately took out the land and property ownership certificate and said, "Zhao Gui, look at it honestly. Your house has been sold to me for thirty-six yuan. Even the name of my Li Qingshan is written on the land and property ownership certificate. This is the government's justice."

"If you say that I am a bandit who has taken over your house."

"What is government?"

"He's also a bandit. Did you help me, a bandit, occupy your house?"

"Based on what you just said, the police are going to arrest you and slander the government's image. Do you believe it?"

Quiet!!

After Li Qingshan finished speaking, Zhao Gui's family was immediately stunned.

Is this... so serious?

You dare not do this to smear the government!

"And you are all neighbors. Let me remind you that this is the land and property ownership certificate given by the government. If you say that I, Li Qingshan, have occupied the Zhao Gui family's house, you are slandering and discrediting the government. You are colluding with me, Li Qingshan, and the government and the people are colluding!"

"When the time comes, the police will come to arrest you, so don't be afraid."

Li Qingshan pointed to the certificate in his hand and said: "One buys and the other sells. I am willing to fight or suffer. There is nothing to say. This house has long been mine, Li Qingshan. I have allowed Zhao Gui to live in it for a few more days. It is already considered as a neighbor in the same village."

"It's really Zhao Gui who is pushing the envelope."

Slander and discredit the government.

In this era, no one dares to shoulder this blame!!

"You're right. This house has been sold to Li Qingshan a long time ago. It's good if Li Qingshan can let you live in it for a few days. If you still want to stay, I think your family wants to occupy Li Qingshan's house."

"Zhao Gui, you are too unreasonable."
